name: DS Cluster D03/D04: FX, Crypto, Indices (curated + free-text)
description: Tests: common_fx_pairs, fx_pairs with ^ prefix, common_crypto_pairs, crypto_pairs with ^ prefix, indices with ^ prefix.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D03/D04: FX, Crypto, Indices
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === CURATED FX ===
eur = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.EURUSD)()
eur_close = eur.c

# === FREE-TEXT FX (^ prefix) ===
gbp = fx_pairs(ticker="GBPUSD")()
gbp_close = gbp.c

# === CURATED CRYPTO ===
btc = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
btc_close = btc.c

# === FREE-TEXT CRYPTO (^ prefix) ===
eth = crypto_pairs(ticker="ETHUSD")()
eth_close = eth.c

# === FREE-TEXT INDEX (^ prefix) ===
rut = indices(ticker="RUT")()
rut_close = rut.c

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="FX: EURUSD vs GBPUSD",
    category="FX",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="EURUSD", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="GBPUSD", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(eur_close, gbp_close))

xy_lines(
    title="Crypto: BTC vs ETH",
    category="Crypto",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(btc_close, eth_close))

histogram(category="Indices", title="Russell 2000", bins=30)(rut_close)
